title.zh: 将新怡诗夏省Talavera市镇Dr. Paulino J. Garcia纪念研究与医疗中心延伸医院床位由10张增至50张并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of Dr. Paulino J. Garcia Memorial Research and Medical Center Extension Hospital in the Municipality of Talavera, Province of Nueva Ecija, From Ten (10) Beds to Fifty (50) Beds Capacity, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The bed capacity of the Dr. Paulino J. Garcia Memorial Research and Medical Center Extension Hospital in the Municipality of Talavera, Province of Nueva Ecija, shall be increased from ten (10) beds to fifty (50) beds capacity. Said extension hospital shall be under the full administrative and technical supervision of the Department of Health.

The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act separate and distinct from the budget of the Department of Health of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
